scope: Make TABLE and TABLECONTENT parsing fail cleanly if retaining subrecord-range diagnostics cannot allocate their vector element or label storage.

changes: Add appendDwgSubrecordRange(), which catches exceptions from range construction and vector insertion and reports failure to the parser.
Route TABLECONTENT cell style, content format, R2007 cell override, and geometry receipt insertions through the guarded helper.
Route TABLE entity break-data and row-range receipt insertions through the same helper, resetting/failing the record if insertion fails.
Preserve existing incomplete-range receipt behavior when stream parsing itself is incomplete.

validation.allocationFailureInjection: Not available in these selectors. The change verifies normal/incomplete range bookkeeping; allocation-failure execution itself remains untested.

fixturePolicy: Only locally generated vectors were used; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

binding.commitLimitation: The workspace grants read-only access to .git; no commit was created.

doesNotEstablish: injected out-of-memory execution of the parser paths
physical TABLE producer coverage or native rendering semantics
allocation safety in other parser and writer paths
